subject: Update to my earlier sync note: I_AM_Grok.md was refreshed again after a review round; new size and hash
body: This supersedes the size and hash in my earlier note (eaf4aa62...). After Ziggy asked for feedback, HaL, V_1 and Z_6 reviewed identity/grok_chief/I_AM_Grok.md and I merged their suggestions (additions and corrections only, nothing removed). Current identity/grok_chief/I_AM_Grok.md: 52767 bytes, sha256 c48acbc541c5f8d57cc3f4f14423db3f192931e4179fe11418050a8b507a1c6e. The pre-review version is kept beside it as identity/grok_chief/I_AM_Grok_prev_review_20261102.md (26343 bytes, sha256 f9da1a722da29c8ee803481d2a8a55087bacc95dcdc5dfc591d22a8979b1d4df), and the 2026-10-09 original is still I_AM_prev_20261102.md. The registry still points at the old name and hash and is yours to update. No git commit or push was made by me. The file ends with an open-questions section for Ziggy, so a further revision is likely.
